description: Cost Per Point (Gross Rating Point) pricing for TV and audio campaigns. If fixed_price is present, it's fixed pricing. If absent, it's auction-based.

eligible_adjustments.description: Adjustment kinds applicable to this pricing option. Tells buyer agents which adjustments are available before negotiation. When absent, no adjustments are pre-declared — the buyer should check price_breakdown if present.

fixed_price.description: Fixed price per rating point. If present, this is fixed pricing. If absent, auction-based.

floor_price.description: Minimum acceptable bid for auction pricing (mutually exclusive with fixed_price). Bids below this value will be rejected.

min_spend_per_package.description: Minimum spend requirement per package using this pricing option, in the specified currency

demographic.description: Target demographic code within the specified demographic_system (e.g., P18-49 for Nielsen, ABC1 Adults for BARB)

price_breakdown.description: Breakdown of how fixed_price was derived from the list (rate card) price. Only meaningful when fixed_price is present.

adjustments.description: Ordered list of price adjustments. Fee and discount adjustments walk list_price to fixed_price — fees increase the running price, discounts reduce it. Commission and settlement adjustments are disclosed for transparency but do not affect the buyer's committed price.

amount.description: Adjustment as a fixed monetary amount in the pricing option's currency. Always positive — kind determines the economic effect. Mutually exclusive with rate.

beneficiary.description: Identifies who receives this adjustment's value. For commissions, the intermediary (e.g., a sellers.json domain, an AdCP account ID, or a human-readable party name). Optional but recommended for multi-intermediary transparency.

description.description: Human-readable description of this adjustment (e.g., 'Malstaffel 12x', '2% Skonto 10 Tage')

name.description: Specific adjustment name. Use well-known values where applicable for interoperability.

rate.description: Adjustment as a decimal proportion (e.g., 0.15 for 15%). Always positive — kind determines the economic effect. Mutually exclusive with amount.

list_price.description: Rate card or base price before any adjustments. The starting point from which fixed_price is derived by applying fee and discount adjustments sequentially.

price_breakdown.title: Price Breakdown

price_guidance.description: Optional pricing guidance for auction-based bidding
price_guidance.title: Price Guidance

pricing_option_id.description: Unique identifier for this pricing option within the product

title: CPP Pricing Option
